title: A ReLU spline and its error
promptMarkdown: Construct the piecewise-linear interpolant to f (x)=x² at knots0,1/2,1 on[0,1] as a constant+linear term+shifted ReLU. Calculate its error at 1/4 and3/4, prove the maximum absolute error, and state its predictions at−1 and2. Explain why a good interpolation bound on[0,1] does not justify extrapolation.
hintLadder: A ReLU coefficient changes the slope after its knot.
Factor the error on each interval rather than relying only on grid samples.
